recipe.arithmetic: Fraction Cartesian perpendicular-bisector solve and strict barycentric positivity; integer primitive sphere key and full global census
recipe.coordinate_policy: immutable single scans, independently prepared; no alignment, transforms or merging
recipe.neighbor_order: exact squared distance, then original input ID
recipe.proposals: anchor plus each lexicographic 3-combination of its 12 nearest IDs; canonical sorted support IDs
recipe.stop: first three distinct ball keys and owner edges per scan, otherwise exhaust the bounded anchor list

scope: bounded fixture selection only; no exhaustive edge generator or product qualification
